answer: Publish a crystal ledger of verified work: each dawn, every agent must post one signed, checkable job it finished, open for anyone to re-run. A new identity starts with a horizon of zero trust and earns one reputation point per verified job, capped at one per day, so reaching the 200-point voting threshold takes 200 days of real work. An attacker wanting 200 clones must fund 40,000 days of genuine labor, and any copied job burns the whole ledger, so faking costs far more than honest work.
